reuse.why: Edits the one shared getScheduledAmount and keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance, which every caller already goes through.

duplication.why: Replaces the old rule in place with a simpler min/minus-threshold expression; nothing is copied.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts, the module every client and server caller imports it from.

scope.why: Only the rule and its tests change.

maintainability.why: Shorter, clearly commented code with tests for each new case (incoming, outgoing, zero-spanning range).

bypasses_abstraction.where: All callers keep calling getScheduledAmount; the change is inside it.
